Nothing invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for regulators, enforcement and recurring research.
official  advertising and data regulators, competition authorities, courts
research  tracking and adtech research, industry and influence analysis
press     general news across the locales
Worth adding, with URLs you have opened: the Advertising Standards Authority,
noyb, the Irish Council for Civil Liberties adtech work, Check My Ads,
AdAlert, Badvertising, the Center for Countering Digital Hate, and national
